addr: L149/A, Ground Floor, WJ8J+5V6, 5th Main Rd, Sector 6, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: This is best chocolate spot in Hsr Layout, where you can get variety of chocolate, hampers and desserts. We have tried new lunches items like Belgian hot chocolate …
Cute little shop , serving some delicious pesto sundried tomato croissant sandwiches and mushroom cheese toast. We ended up getting croissants (and a brownie) packed for take away as well! …

I order a *Butterscotch Bento Monin cake 300gms * on Sunday night 26th April
Via Zomato …
